says: plant-check's header says a law's options argument is not part of the law, but lawsOf strips options only when the last argument is an object literal, so an options argument in second place, a number timeout, or options passed by name stays in the body; moving such a law onto the package's it changes its body and makes it a changed law that needs its own plant run.
proof: lawsOf, lines 198 and 204: options = args.length >= 3 && last.type === "ObjectExpression" ? last : undefined; body = shape(options === undefined ? args.slice(1) : args.slice(1, -1)). So it(t, { timeout: 900_000 }, fn) becomes it(t, fn, { timeout: 900_000 }) and the body changes, against the header's 'Its options argument ... are not part of it'. Seen on next/apps/fabrika/src/build.integration.test.ts:363 and next/apps/fabrika/src/exam/bytes.integration.test.ts:229 and 348.
cost: Slice C of the 0591 sweep left eight files undeclared; the 0580 sweep meets the same cost on every vitest-style file it moves to the package's it.
